name: VIP Lifetime Discount
description: Apply 20% discount for customers with lifetime spend over $10,000

name: New Customer Welcome
description: Apply 10% discount on first purchase for newly registered customers

name: Bulk Order Discount
description: Apply 15% discount when order quantity exceeds 50 units

name: Flash Sale Eligibility
description: Customer eligible for flash sale if not used flash sale in last 90 days

name: Premium Shipping Upgrade
description: Automatically upgrade to free express shipping for orders above $200

name: Fraud High Risk Block
description: Block transaction if device fingerprint matches known fraud list

name: Velocity Check
description: Flag account if more than 5 transactions within 10 minutes

name: Geographic Anomaly
description: Require additional verification if login location differs from usual by more than 500km

name: Loyalty Points Multiplier
description: Triple loyalty points for purchases in customer birthday month

name: Subscription Renewal Discount
description: Apply 25% discount on subscription renewal if customer tenure exceeds 2 years

name: Abandoned Cart Recovery
description: Eligible for 5% recovery coupon if cart abandoned for 24-48 hours

name: Cross-sell Bundle Eligibility
description: Show bundle offer if customer bought from category A but not category B in last 60 days

name: Refund Abuse Detection
description: Flag account if refund rate exceeds 30% of orders in last 6 months

name: Employee Purchase Restriction
description: Block discount stacking for accounts flagged as employee accounts

name: Seasonal Clearance Eligibility
description: Allow access to clearance pricing only for accounts created before current season start
